status: Research geometric repair; anatomical boundary remains unvalidated

method: Axial 1.6 mm closing and enclosed 2D hole filling; retain all cross-section components

3D closing radius 1.6 mm, fill enclosed 3D and axial cavities
Reconstruct both persistent terminal source components separately from extended slice 279 with 0.8 mm local closing; preserve their separation
Final signed-distance regularization sigma 0.65 mm, enclosed 2D/3D cavity fill, largest 3D component
Surface only: 10 windowed-sinc iterations, pass band 0.1
limitations: Derived computational lumen; branch identities and true tissue boundaries remain unvalidated
Morphological repair changes the boundary and can suppress small features
Two meaningful terminal channels are retained; reconstructed separation begins one slice below the original persistent separation
Surface cap locations are voxel crop ends, not final CFD inlet/outlet cuts
Original CT orientation inferred from file/image consistency, not independently verified with DICOM
